summary: RFC 6598 says reverse DNS queries for Shared Address Space, 100.64.0.0/10, must not go to the global DNS. This best current practice directs IANA to add the matching zones to the IPv4 Locally-Served DNS Zones registry so such queries do not leak out.

eli5.summary: Some addresses are only for private use. This makes sure questions about their names are answered locally and never sent out to the world.
